Five amplifiers, all running, all tuned: parallel x1.3, speed x1.4, primary output x2.0, secondary output x1.6, steam saver x1.1. Each running amplifier bills fluid by its tier — 4/8/12/16 L/s — and the multipliers land on the steam account.

The caps are the exam: primary-output boosts take only the highest of their kind, secondary boosts add up, and steam savings cap at 48 percent total. A fully amplified cluster is a different machine than the one you built — the question every cluster engineer answers differently is how much parallel you can afford.

Run all five at once for a full processing session and check in.
